scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npx esbuild src/content/analyzer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/analyzer-bundle.js --format=iife && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/manifest.json')); m.content_scripts=[{matches:['*://*.linkedin.com/*'],js:['analyzer-bundle.js']}]; fs.writeFileSync('dist/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(m,null,2))"
